claims.claim: The host and required command-line environment were directly inventoried.

No host-native SWI-Prolog or PeTTa command is installed; the current inspected PeTTa is the ClarityOmega linux/amd64 container at commit 6b7f52f064bdbc82fabd0a0998404121fb01d52e with SWI-Prolog 9.2.4 and a native Prolog-import path.
LM Studio responds on 127.0.0.1:1234 and exposes the exact Qwen, Nemotron, and embedding model identifiers recorded in the baseline.

ClarityOmega uses ChromaDB 1.5.9 as an embedded PersistentClient over its own bind-mounted persistence; the completion snapshot is memories, dimension 1024, 44,643 embeddings, with no standalone HTTP listener.
The exact future Miter deployment is pinned and isolated in a plan; no image, container, volume, collection, migration, or backup was created.
The private NRC VAD Lexicon 2.1 asset was identified by declared version, local path, size, and SHA-256 only; its data was not copied into evidence.
Mattermost 11.7.7 is healthy at 127.0.0.1:8065 and no credential was read.
All 25 supplied implementation-evidence sources and all five ratified authorities are present and hashed.
Nonexistent service, model, and collection identifiers were reported unavailable/not found without substitution.

The three protected documents retained their entry hashes. The user-initiated ClarityOmega restart changed the live Chroma persistence, and that delta is preserved rather than misattributed to the audit.

remaining_unproven_assumptions: Which PeTTa commit will be selected and proven for native arm64 macOS in G01: the ClarityOmega pin 6b7f52f064bdbc82fabd0a0998404121fb01d52e or current upstream ae66fa8e41dcd5539d614706bd4e5cfb34f9608d.
A native macOS PeTTa/SWI-Prolog installation does not yet exist and its clean build has not been proven.
LM Studio's CLI reports its server as off even though both model APIs return HTTP 200; the HTTP result is authoritative for this baseline but the CLI discrepancy remains unexplained.
The proposed Miter Chroma endpoint, volume, and collection do not exist yet and are intentionally unproven until G09.
A dedicated Mattermost test account/channel and its credential profile have not been selected or inspected.
decision_required_before_g01: Select the PeTTa source commit for the native arm64 clean-build proof. The current ClarityOmega pin is compatibility-proven only in linux/amd64; current upstream is newer but not yet proven against the Miter requirements.
